fixes.explanation: Creative, baker, and Jesus was passing through Jericho (Luke 19:1). But the people said, “He has gone to be the guest of a sinful man!” (Luke 19:7) Nobody in that crowd is griping about being passed by. I think that crowd had a lot to say about who got the dinner invitation.

The courts never come up in the text. Zacchaeus says, “…if I have cheated anyone, I will repay it fourfold.” (Luke 19:8) Nobody is dragging him anywhere. I think a man who offers four times the amount on his own is a man who doesn't need a judge.

problems.problem: The ending still restates the quoted complaint without adding much personality or insight.
The ending still relies on the generic observation that Zacchaeus himself makes the promise.
